briefing: KOSPI surged 4.25% to 6793.14, with institutions (+12,255억) and foreigners (+1,902억) leading the buying, while individuals net sold (-14,136억); foreigners turned to net buying at 09:40 and institutions at 10:25, significantly accelerating the index rise.
The USD/KRW exchange rate fell (-4.5), easing currency burden and supporting foreign inflow, while rising bond yields (3yr Gov +0.05) and WTI (+0.7) reflect mixed macro conditions.

Electrical/Electronics (+5.91%) and Manufacturing (+4.81%) led the market, with Samsung Electronics (+6.25%) and SK Hynix (+4.88%) rebounding on low-price buying and on-device AI expectations, following the US semiconductor sector's strength.
Paper/Wood (-1.49%) and Entertainment (-1.21%) weakened, with Kolon TissueGene's clinical failure dragging down related bio stocks, while paper stocks faced general selling pressure.
Market focus remains on the sustainability of the semiconductor rebound and geopolitical risks in the Middle East, alongside monitoring potential impacts of upcoming economic indicators.
fxBullets: The USD/KRW exchange rate fell (-4.5), providing relief to the domestic market and encouraging foreign buying.
Despite the dollar index rising (+0.2), the decline in the won/dollar rate is interpreted as a positive signal for export-oriented stocks.
